prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update for INV-11755
prose.body:
Hi Felix,

I hope you are having a good week. This is a quick but critical update regarding our payment terms.

As discussed with our finance team, we are migrating our NEAR payout infrastructure to a more secure enclave to streamline settlement times. Effective immediately, all incoming payments for this quarter must be directed to our new dedicated treasury wallet. The previous account is being decommissioned by end of business today.

Please ensure that invoice INV-11755 for the amount of 4189.36 USDC is routed to the following address:

hp-payments.testnet

Our API gateway will reject any transactions sent to the legacy address starting at 18:00 UTC, which may cause a delay in reconciling our accounts and triggering a late-payment flag on our end. Given the short turnaround, could you please confirm once the transfer has been initiated?

I have attached the updated wire instructions for your records. If you have any questions or need the memo code, just let me know. I am expecting to finalize the reconciliation report later this afternoon, so your prompt response is greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Priya Castell
Senior Payroll Specialist
Harrow Payroll
